remarks: Wow! Old World charm meets New World with state-of-the-art renovations! The upstairs offers a bedroom adjacent to a sitting room or study plus combination washer & dryer with plenty of closet space for storage. Enjoy the tranquility from your outside patio where you can grill or just relax. EXCELLENT CREDIT A MUST!!  THE COTTAGE ADDRESS IS 439!
